text:
Iris: Heads-up — Beryl POC hit quota_exceeded during a customer-run stress demo. They say portal shows ~10k trial credits but API returned 429s and streaming stopped. Can someone look?

Dylan: Do we have the raw error or response headers? Need to tell if it's rate-limit or credits.

Beryl (via SE): Pasted: > {"error":"quota_exceeded","code":429,"detail":"credits_zero"}. No headers in screenshot. Portal still shows 10000 credits in UI.

ME-SE: Tagging @infra-oncall and @billing-bot. Also request a short customer-friendly note explaining how streaming token consumption maps to credits so they aren't surprised post-demo.

infra-oncall: Quick check of edge logs for acct beryl-poc: found responses with:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-rate-limit-limit: 200
x-rate-limit-remaining: 0
x-rate-limit-reset: 10
x-account-credits: 0
x-account-tokens-used: 10234
```
Primary issue: billing DB shows credits_remaining=0; portal cache appears stale.

billing-bot: Spend alert fired for beryl-poc: usage $1,120.75 threshold $1,000 at 2026-05-10T15:42:01Z. Credits on file: 0.

Iris: Ok, two-parter: (1) customer-facing fix — short explanation + credits top-up for demo, (2) internal fix — why portal cache was stale.

Dylan: Can we grant a temporary top-up for the demo window and mute alerts?

ops-manager: Finance approvals needed for grants > $500. Approver: @ops-manager or @Sam-Finance. I'm approving for demo continuity.

Dylan: Executing admin grant: `redwood admin grant-credits --acct beryl-poc --amount 12000 --note \"POC demo top-up\"`

billing-bot: Manual credit grant recorded: +12000 credits by Dylan at 2026-05-10T15:44:03Z.

infra-oncall: Invalidated portal cache for acct beryl-poc: `POST /internal/cache/invalidate?key=acct:beryl-poc`. Portal now reports 12000 credits. Muted spend alerts for 2h: `POST /alerts/mute?acct=beryl-poc&duration=2h`. Temporarily increased soft rate-limit 200->800 for 3 hours.

ME-SE: Replayed customer's curl sample: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer <demo-key>\" https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-1\",\"prompt\":\"hello\"}'` Response 200 streaming; header `x-account-credits: 11995`.

Iris: I'll send the customer note: one short para explaining: portal cache mismatch after a migration job, we topped up demo credits and muted alerts for the window, and we'll follow up to explain streaming token accounting.

ops-manager: Internal follow-ups logged: BILL-2026-300 (reconcile manual grants), INF-2026-618 (add post-migration cache invalidation test + alert when portal/billing delta > 500 credits), and DOCS-POC-12 (SE FAQ on streaming tokens vs credits).

ME-SE: For the customer FAQ snippet: "Streaming responses consume tokens continuously; partial tokens can be billed on flush, so long-running streams may burn credits faster than you expect. We'll walk through sample prompts and expected burn rates in a follow-up." Keep it short.

Dylan: I'll also add a defensive check in the proxy to return a clearer error when credits==0 vs rate-limit so SEs and customers see an explicit message.

Iris: Thanks team. Demo resumed. Please ping if anything reappears. :thumbsup:
